integrity: Analytic proof with exact model assumptions and endpoints. Independent multinomial exact-rational checks of 2,197 parameter triples, nonuniqueness examples, and one seeded sampling diagnostic support reproducibility; they are not universal proofs.
scientific_limitations: Three-dimensional orthogonal rectangular boxes; Euclidean distances between two independent volume-uniform points; exact population moments only. Historical priority not independently certified; the 1999 cube article could not be retrieved in full. Uniform inverse Hölder exponent 1/3 is sharp, its numerical constant is not claimed sharp.
title: Sharp three-moment tomography of rectangular solids
